text_block_list.text:
While Эйр Грув is hard at work, her
old
acquaintance Сайленс Судзука is also
garnering
attention from the racing
world at large.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two of them enter a scrimmage,
where Air
Groove loses utterly to this
Umamusume known
as the Otherworldly
Front-Runner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Identifying Сайленс Судзука as a major
obstacle to
overcome, Эйр Грув makes
it her next goal to
defeat her at the
Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
